node.title: KoalaBear near-positive 30-cell direct residual registry
node.closure: exact direct compiler for all 30 residual affine literal orbit representatives
node.statement: The affine near-positive literal frontier remaining after the exact inversion transports is the disjoint 5-by-2-by-3 registry with assignment representatives F02,F04,F06,M01,M03, target-root representatives A,OB, and allocations RX,RL,RM. Generic 5-by-5 source reconstruction over QQ(b,c,d) compiles each cell to four nonzero cleared q-slice equations together with its complete radical named-open localizer set. The registry contains exactly 30 cells and 120 equations, has SHA-256 2607f88572c63091b06a1c35dd55c80a3e4f10daff2fb3423f5bb8c03f0f116e, maximum equation total degree 30, maximum 1,098 terms, and no four-equation common factor in any cell. This is a compiler and census, not an emptiness theorem.
